description: The script rendered search shell now carries a noindex directive and no longer appears in the map file, so crawlers spend attention on real writing.
lead: The search page ships an empty shell that fills in only after script runs, yet it invited crawlers with a canonical address and a map entry. The page now asks crawlers not to index it while staying reachable for readers, and the map file lists only real reading pages. No layout, style or structured data changed; pages unrelated to the search shell and this entry rebuild byte-identical from committed sources.
merge_note: Merge pending; the merge record is updated here after release approval and merge.

reasoning.DEV: The generator change reuses the existing page renderer and adds one small optional slot, so no new visual language was introduced. The search shell keeps its layout, style and structured data while gaining a crawl directive and leaving the map file. Every other page renders byte-identical output because the new slot stays empty unless set.
reasoning.Director: This change adjusts generator metadata inside the cleared pattern with no new pages or components. Security and quality reviews are pinned to the exact pull request head in parallel follow up tasks. Release approval fires only when both verdicts pass that exact head.

stages.rationale: The remote and the login checked out, and a fresh branch was cut from the main line.
The page renderer gained an optional crawl directive slot, the search page sets it, and the map file drops the shell entry.
The change plus the log entry was pushed and the pull request opened for parallel review.

title: Search shell steps out of the crawl map
